description: Recommended ML top-1 confidence thresholds for words NOT resolved by shortcut.json, measured on held-out val.jsonl (v3 model, is_full rows only). Not yet consumed by the iOS/Android apps -- for future auto-commit integration. 'threshold' is the softmax top-1 probability cutoff; 'weighted_coverage' is the frequency-weighted fraction of the ML-fallback population that clears it.
